description: This file defines functions related to mapping commit data to CSV format, including generating CSV headers, converting commit entities to CSV rows, quoting strings, and converting multiple commit entities into CSV rows.

methods.name: CommitCSVHeader
methods.description: Returns the CSV header row as a slice of strings.

methods.name: CommitEntityToCSVRow
methods.description: Converts an AnalyzedCommitRow entity into a CSV row with all fields quoted.

methods.name: CommitEntitiesToCSVRows
methods.description: Converts a slice of AnalyzedCommitRow entities into a slice of CSV rows.

methods.name: quoteAll
methods.description: Quotes all strings in a slice.
